title: 论述用词的搭配
goal: 区分论述动词表达的关系；选择与宾语和介词相配的用词。

points.label: 区分论述动词表达的关系
选择与宾语和介词相配的用词

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 论述搭配既决定意思，也决定句子结构。affect 后面直接接受影响的对象，只说有影响，不说出现什么结果。lead to 后接结果，result from 后接原因，两者方向相反。

body.box: Noise can affect concentration. Repeated interruptions can lead to mistakes. Those mistakes may result from lost concentration.

body.p: suggest doing 表示建议，require someone to do 表示要求某人去做。The tutor suggested revising the introduction. The supervisor required the writer to revise it. 前一句是建议，后一句是要求，两者不能换用。

cards.title: 词汇表：原因影响
rows: Available evidence should influence a decision.
The timetable has an effect on attendance.
Unclear instructions may lead to repeated questions.
A missing label can result in confusion.
Confusion may result from a missing label.
Regular practice can contribute to improvement.
A faulty sensor may account for the unusual reading.
Conflicting instructions can give rise to uncertainty.
Prior experience can play a role in interpretation.
cards.note: contribute to 表示是原因之一。The delay contributed to the failure. 说明延误是失败的原因之一，还可能有其他原因。

cards.title: 词汇表：问题措施
rows: A clearer procedure could address the problem.
The team met to tackle the difficulty.
The office took measures to reduce delays.
The manager took action after reviewing the complaints.
The department implemented a policy on shared storage.
Extended hours can meet a need for evening access.
The fund provides support for new participants.
The adviser suggested checking the figures again.
The procedure requires staff to record each change.
A locked account prevented the user from editing the file.
cards.note: suggest 后接动名词：suggest checking。不说 suggest someone to check。

cards.title: 词汇表：证据结论
rows: The log provides evidence of repeated checks.
The comparison supports the claim about waiting time.
A reviewer should examine the evidence before drawing a conclusion.
The group reached a conclusion after discussing both accounts.
The panel based its judgment on the submitted work.
The entry is consistent with the original record.
The discrepancy calls the earlier estimate into question.
The repeated observations indicate a trend.
The reasons given do not justify the decision.
The report distinguishes between intentions and outcomes.
cards.note: support 表示证据支持某个主张，但没有彻底证明它。The record supports the claim. 之后，其他解释仍可能成立。

cards.title: 词汇表：利弊评价
rows: The adjustable design offers an advantage in a small room.
Loose cables pose a risk to people using the passage.
The continuing costs may outweigh the benefits.
The arrangement has a drawback: access depends on one key.
Detailed feedback can be beneficial to new contributors.
Repeated interruptions can be detrimental to careful work.
A shorter trial is worth considering.
A clear label can make a difference.
The rule seeks to strike a balance between access and protection.
The proposal takes maintenance costs into account.
cards.note: outweigh 的主语是分量更重的一方。Costs outweigh benefits. 表示成本大于益处，两者对调后意思相反。take into account 也可写成 take account of：The plan takes account of upkeep costs.

body.box: A shared workshop is considering a booking rule. The organizers believe that predictable access could influence members’ willingness to begin longer projects. This is a claim about an influence, not a guarantee that more projects will be completed. A trial could provide evidence of changes in booking behavior. If missed appointments fall, the organizers should still examine other possible causes before drawing a conclusion. They may suggest using reminders during the trial, while requiring members to record cancellations under the booking rule.

body.p: influence 表示影响，没有说一定出现什么结果。provide evidence of 后接名词短语。before 是介词，后面用动名词 drawing。suggest using 是建议；requiring members to record 是要求，写明了谁做、做什么。

items.stem: A trial may influence attendance, but no increase has been established. Which phrase preserves that relation?
items.why: 题干说 no increase has been established。第一项 may affect 只说可能有影响，没有说出勤一定增加。

items.stem: Errors occurred because instructions conflicted. Which phrase puts errors first and keeps the cause second?
options: Errors gave rise to conflicting instructions.
items.why: instructions conflicted 是原因。result from 后接原因，即第二项。第一项 resulted in 把因果方向说反了。

items.stem: Choose the pair: The adviser suggested ___ the comparison; the panel required the writer ___ the figures.
items.why: suggest 后接动名词 revising，require the writer 后接不定式 to check，即第三项。

items.stem: Choose the pair: The log provides evidence ___ a fault and is consistent ___ the inspection notes.
items.why: evidence 后用 of 接证据的内容，consistent 后用 with，即第四项。第一项把两个介词放反了。

items.stem: A proposal has both lower initial costs and higher upkeep costs. Which wording expresses comparison rather than guaranteed success?
options: The initial savings eliminate every upkeep cost.
The upkeep costs may outweigh the initial savings.
The upkeep costs are identical to the initial savings.
The initial savings prove that upkeep is unnecessary.
items.why: 题干说初期成本低、维护成本高。第二项用 may outweigh 比较两者，并保留可能的语气。

items.stem: Choose the standard pattern: The report distinguishes ___ intended outcomes and observed changes.
items.why: 空后是 intended outcomes and observed changes，两个对象用 and 连接，要用 between。用 from 时，第一个对象要放在 distinguish 和 from 之间。

items.stem: A missed call was one of several reasons for delay. Which expression keeps it as a partial cause?
options: was the sole cause of the delay
was the result of the delay
items.why: one of several reasons 说明是原因之一，对应第三项 contributed to。第一项 sole cause 说成了唯一原因。

items.stem: The current evidence supports a claim but does not settle every objection. Which wording preserves this limit?
options: The evidence gives support to the claim.
The evidence proves every objection incorrect.
The evidence shows the claim has no support.
The evidence settles every objection to the claim.
items.why: 题干说 supports a claim but does not settle every objection。第一项 gives support to 只说支持，没有说解决了所有反对意见。

items.stem: Which form fits: The funding provides support ___ participants unable to pay the initial fee?
items.why: provide support for 接支持对象 participants。

items.stem: Which pattern is correct: A locked account prevented the assistant ___ the entry?
items.why: prevent someone from doing 要求 from changing。

items.stem: A discrepancy makes an earlier estimate doubtful. Which expression fits this effect?
options: bases the discrepancy on the estimate
makes the estimate consistent with every record
items.why: doubtful 说明估计受到质疑，对应第四项 calls the estimate into question。

items.stem: Which phrase completes: The alternative is ___ before a permanent decision is made?
items.why: be worth doing 中 worth 后接动名词。

items.stem: A report says clearer instructions could affect the speed of assembly, but it does not establish that they always prevent mistakes. Which wording preserves its claim?
options: Clearer instructions may influence assembly speed without guaranteeing error-free work.
Clearer instructions guarantee error-free assembly whenever the work is completed more quickly.
Faster assembly proves that clearer instructions have prevented every possible mistake.
Assembly mistakes show that instructions cannot influence the speed of any task.
items.why: 报告说 could affect the speed of assembly，没有说一定避免错误。第一项用 may influence 保留了可能影响的意思。

items.stem: The office recommends using reminders but makes cancellation records compulsory. Which wording keeps the difference between advice and obligation?
options: The office requires members to use reminders and merely suggests recording cancellations.
The office suggests using reminders and requires members to record cancellations.
The office suggests using reminders and also merely suggests recording cancellations.
The office requires neither reminders nor cancellation records under its current arrangement.
items.why: recommends 对应 suggests，compulsory 对应 requires，即第二项。第一项把建议和要求对调了。

items.stem: Several factors explain a delayed launch, including a shortage of trained staff. Which expression accurately describes the shortage without excluding other factors?
options: The shortage was the sole cause of the delay in launching the service.
The shortage resulted from the delay in launching the service.
The shortage contributed to the delay in launching the service.
The shortage was unrelated to the delay in launching the service.
items.why: Several factors ... including 说明人手不足是原因之一。第三项 contributed to 表达的正是部分原因。

items.stem: A new allocation rule saves time but requires costly maintenance. The writer says the costs might exceed the savings. Which expression preserves that evaluation?
options: The savings necessarily outweigh every maintenance cost created by the rule.
The maintenance costs are guaranteed to equal the savings achieved by the rule.
The savings show that the maintenance costs cannot affect evaluation of the rule.
The maintenance costs may outweigh the savings achieved by the rule.
items.why: 作者说 the costs might exceed the savings。第四项 may outweigh 的主语是成本，方向一致，也保留了可能的语气。

items.stem: Use effect with an indefinite article to complete the phrase: A clearer layout can have ___ how visitors find the services they need inside the building.
items.why: have an effect on 后接受影响的对象。effect 后面用 on，不用 to。

items.stem: Use consistent and its required preposition after be: The final account should be ___ the observations recorded during the inspection of the shared equipment.
items.why: be consistent with 表与记录一致，with 不能省略。

items.stem: Use beneficial and its required preposition after be: A brief induction may be ___ staff who have not previously used the booking system for shared rooms.
items.why: be beneficial to 接受益对象 staff。

items.stem: Use take and account, with the required preposition, after should: The final proposal should ___ the additional time needed for checking the archived records.
items.why: take into account 与 take account of 都可接后面的完整名词短语，表示考虑到。
